newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end up after light trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end up after light trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up slightly in a day of light trading, brokers said.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose 0.57 percent to 18,017.41 pesos on volume of 2.4 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB index rose 0.35 percent to 1,185.73 on below-average volume of 511 million pesos.
"There was demand, but few were selling," said one Bogota- based broker. "For that reason the prices went up."

Giant Colombian brewer Bavaria was one of the day's biggest winners, jumping 1.85 percent to 7,900 pesos per share on volume of 63 million in Bogota and up 1.87 percent to 7,900 on volume of 135 million in Medellin.

Banco de Bogota, the nation's third largest bank in terms of assets, moved up 0.83 percent to 6,606 pesos per share on volume of 4.9 million in Bogota and 0.76 percent to 6,600 on volume of 28 million in Medellin.
Cement maker Compania de Cementos Argos rose 0.28 percent to 8,535 in Bogota and by 0.42 percent to 8,547 in Medellin.
